```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(knitr)
```

```{r}
cloak <- read_csv("Invisibility Cloak.csv")

cloak <- cloak %>%
  mutate(
    Cloak = factor(Cloak,
                   levels = c(0,1),
                   labels = c("Without a cloak","With a cloak"))
  )

# ASSUMPTION 1: CONTINUOUS DV
is.numeric(cloak$Mischief)

# ASSUMPTION 2: TWO GROUPS
levels(cloak$Cloak)
nlevels(cloak$Cloak)
table(cloak$Cloak)

# ASSUMPTION 3: INDEPENDENCE
nrow(cloak)
length(unique(cloak$Participant))
any(duplicated(cloak$Participant))

# ASSUMPTION 4: OUTLIERS
ggplot(cloak, aes(x=Cloak, y=Mischief)) + geom_boxplot()

cloak %>%
  group_by(Cloak) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(Mischief,0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(Mischief,0.75),
    IQR = IQR(Mischief),
    Lower = Q1 - 1.5*IQR,
    Upper = Q3 + 1.5*IQR
  )

cloak %>%
  group_by(Cloak) %>%
  filter(
    Mischief < quantile(Mischief,0.25) - 1.5*IQR(Mischief) |
    Mischief > quantile(Mischief,0.75) + 1.5*IQR(Mischief)
  )

# ASSUMPTION 5: NORMALITY
by(cloak$Mischief, cloak$Cloak, shapiro.test)

ggplot(cloak, aes(x=Mischief)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=8) +
  facet_wrap(~Cloak)

# HOMOGENEITY OF VARIANCE
leveneTest(Mischief ~ Cloak, data=cloak)

# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
descriptives <- cloak %>%
  group_by(Cloak) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean = mean(Mischief),
    SD = sd(Mischief),
    Min = min(Mischief),
    Max = max(Mischief)
  )
kable(descriptives, digits=2)

# T-TEST
t_result <- t.test(Mischief ~ Cloak, data=cloak, var.equal=TRUE)
t_result

# APA REPORT
m1 <- mean(cloak$Mischief[cloak$Cloak=="Without a cloak"])
sd1 <- sd(cloak$Mischief[cloak$Cloak=="Without a cloak"])

m2 <- mean(cloak$Mischief[cloak$Cloak=="With a cloak"])
sd2 <- sd(cloak$Mischief[cloak$Cloak=="With a cloak"])

t_value <- unname(t_result$statistic)
df_value <- unname(t_result$parameter)
p_value <- unname(t_result$p.value)
ci_low <- t_result$conf.int[1]
ci_high <- t_result$conf.int[2]

cat(
"An independent-samples t-test was conducted to determine whether wearing an invisibility cloak affected mischievous behavior. ",
"Participants without a cloak (M = ", round(m1,2), ", SD = ", round(sd1,2),
") and participants with a cloak (M = ", round(m2,2), ", SD = ", round(sd2,2),
") did not differ significantly, t(", round(df_value,0), ") = ", round(t_value,2),
", p = ", format(round(p_value,3), nsmall=3),
", 95% CI [", round(ci_low,2), ", ", round(ci_high,2), "]. ",
sep=""
)
```
